newsitem.title: USA: Telebras falls in N.Y. trade.
newsitem.headline: Telebras falls in N.Y. trade.

text.p: Brazilian telephone holding Telebras fell on Wednesday, in part because of profit-taking, traders said.
Telebras American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) fell 3-3/8 to 105-5/8 in moderate trade. Telebras was the most heavily traded ADR in mid-afternoon.
Traders said Telebras was being weighed by a slumping Dow Jones Industrial Average and profit-taking following a recent sharp rise. Since Feb 27 Telebras has soared from 96.
"It's up pretty big. I just think there is room for a breather in Brazil," a trader said. "There is no fundamental news on the stock" to cause the decline.
Telebras also was hit by the Brazilian Supreme Court's putting off until Thursday a ruling on the constitutionality of a law regulating the privatization of the telecommunications sector.
